name: Toaru Hahaoya no Ayamachi ~Yukari Hen~
original_name: とある母親の過ち～縁篇～
source:
"Mother has been acting weird lately..."
thought Kento, sensing something between her and a friend.
So he began surreptitiously reading his friend's blog... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE188734.html]DLsite English[/url]]
